primary_task: Capture a conversation or decision as a structured page in a Notion database.

requirements.name: Notion
requirements.evidence: "Draft the page with `Notion:notion-create-pages` using the database's schema"
requirements.basis: notion: Notion connector (the user's workspace): notion-search, notion-fetch, notion-create-pages, notion-update-page, notion-create-database

requirements.name: codex CLI (codex mcp add notion)
requirements.evidence: "### 0) If any MCP call fails because Notion MCP is not connected ... `codex mcp add notion --url https://mcp.notion.com/mcp`"
requirements.basis: grants lists "notion_account"; codex is not listed and mcp.notion.com is not an open host: "other hosts are refused"

notes: Setup step 0 is a failure-only path. If Notion were not connected its remedy would be unavailable here.
